title: A test n-form on ℝⁿ supported in a given closed ball with positive integral
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ (n = 0 allowed), p ∈ ℝⁿ and r > 0. There is a test form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝⁿ) (TestFormOn univ n: a smooth compactly supported n-form on ℝⁿ = Euclid n) with tsupport ω ⊆ closedBall(p, r) and ∫_{ℝⁿ} ω(y)(e₁, …, eₙ) dy > 0, where (e₁, …, eₙ) = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ is the standard orthonormal basis and dy is Lebesgue measure (volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Euclid n) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) ⊆ closedBall p r ∧ 0 < ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)
